question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"impacted."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb tense in the sentence is past tense. • The correct word **"impacted"** means to have a strong effect on something. (किसी चीज़ पर गहरा प्रभाव डालना) • **Example**: *Falling export rates have **impacted**__ (on) the country's economy quite considerably.* • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: Isolation and loneliness __caused__ by the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown policies negatively __**impacted**__ the mental health of the public throughout the entire globe. These result in an increase in emotional ______ (3) ______, ______ (4) ______ of hopelessness and extreme anxiety, which are ______ (5) ______ by variations in emotional responses and style of living. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (shown) **means to display or exhibit something. (to let somebody see somebody/something. (किसी को कोई व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु देखने देना; दिखाना, प्रदर्शित करना) • **Option 2 (did)** is a past tense auxiliary verb used to form questions and negatives, or to add emphasis to a statement. (किया) • **Option 3 (formed)** means to come into existence or be created. (कुछ होने की शुरुआत होना; अस्तित्‍व में आना) 1e5:Te47, The correct answer is **"stress."**
